svg.title: Source organisation and release compatibility are separate decisions

g.text: WHO CAN CHANGE THE SOURCE TOGETHER?
One source commit can update several modules.
It does not make deployment atomic.
A monorepo can publish a customer-held SDK.
WHICH VERSIONS CAN STILL BE IN USE?
Include owned mobile apps, rolling deploys,
stored data and messages awaiting replay.
A source update does not upgrade every device.

svg.text: Rollback requires compatible code, schemas, retained data and keys throughout the declared window.
Use a build identity everywhere; add a compatibility promise wherever old and new versions must coexist.
